name: Hearth beef
summary: Beef smoked on the same hearth as the buffalo. Báo Sơn La, on 15 May 2025, says the Chiềng Cơi workshop smokes buffalo, beef, and sausage: cut along the grain, mắc khén, garlic, ginger, and chili, 1–2 hours, then about 6–8 hours to a dark brown.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 15 May 2025. Tổ 3, phường Chiềng Cơi.
taste: The workshop account says fragrant, mildly hot, and still sweet, for the hearth meats together.
howToEat: As the smoked beef, or carry it. A price and an hour are Check on arrival.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi. No stall is a pick.
seoTitle: Bo gac bep in Son La — hearth beef
seoDescription: Thịt bò gác bếp in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La smokes it with the buffalo in Chiềng Cơi, about 6–8 hours. A price is Check on arrival.
